details.description: Runs on each laptop. DNS server address is saved in OS network settings. Public household root is trusted in OS/browser certificate storage. Browser stores session cookie; renders Spanish pages + htmx. Caddy runs on the Pi.

SwiftUI runs on each iPhone. Pi DNS IP is saved in Wi-Fi settings for the household network. Public root profile is installed and full trust enabled in iOS Settings. URLSession uses that trust; hs_sess_ token lives in Keychain. Allow Local Network access.

Runs on the household laptop. OS network settings point DNS to the Pi. Public CA PEM is stored locally; runtime trust configuration points to it. API key lives in process environment. HTTPS /mcp reaches Caddy on the Pi.

Physical host: DNS, Caddy, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and all server volumes live here. APP is the nested process boundary. Clients remain outside this host. Router supplies Wi-Fi/DHCP; no router configuration or internet port forwarding required.

Pi-hole dns container on the Raspberry Pi. LAN UDP/TCP 53. home-companion.home.arpa maps to the active Caddy host IP; record and upstream DNS settings persist in dns_config mounted at /etc/pihole. Each client manually selects Pi DNS. Router DHCP stays in place.

proxy container on Raspberry Pi. LAN 443 HTTPS; 80 redirects. Read-only Caddyfile mounted at /etc/caddy/Caddyfile defines tls internal and reverse_proxy app:8080; blocks Actuator. Internal CA issues/renews certificates using caddy_data. No DNS or trust installation on clients through this proxy.

Docker named volume on Raspberry Pi disk, mounted only into Caddy at /data. Persists private CA keys and server certificates. Export only public root at /data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt for client trust. Losing this CA requires trusting a new root on clients.
Deployment boundary: app container on Raspberry Pi, one Java 25 JVM. Port 8080 is private to Compose. Caddy forwards HTTP to app:8080. Internal arrows are in-process calls or port implementations.
SecurityConfig; CredentialFilter; RequestAuthorization. RequestActorResolver.resolve(request): Actor. Fresh Accounts verdict on every request.
Package grouping. Two delivery adapters, same core contracts.
GroceryWebController(queries, commands). stock(actor): View; add(actor, form): redirect / fragment. Auth, accounts, admin, images.
GroceryApiController(queries, commands). stock(actor): DTO; add(actor, request): result. Auth, features, accounts, images.
GroceryTools(queries, commands). 3 list tools + groceries_add_stock. Stateless HTTP; READ_WRITE and owner EDIT for additions.
CredentialService(repository, hasher). resolve(token); PermissionEvaluator.effective(credential,module). Accounts, grants, keys, module catalogue.
GroceryQueries / GroceryCommands(repository, imageStore). addStock(actor, command). ShoppingListCalculator: needed=max(0,target−stock).
Actor(userId,credentialId,permission); TokenHasher; ImageStore port; ImageRef. No dependency on adapters or other core modules.
JpaAccountRepository; JpaGroceryRepository; LocalImageStore. Implements core ports; transactions, parameterized SQL and image re-encoding.
postgres container on Raspberry Pi. pgdata is a Docker volume on Pi disk. Accounts, grants, hashed credentials, current groceries and 24 h deduplication. Port 5432 stays private to Compose.
Docker named volume on Raspberry Pi disk mounted into app. LocalImageStore reads and writes validated PNG/JPEG output; accepts PNG, JPEG and still WebP input.

Household administrator configures Pi DNS records and Caddyfile on the Pi. On each laptop/iPhone: save Pi IP as DNS server and trust the public CA certificate. DNS queries go directly to Pi-hole; HTTPS goes to Caddy. No CA private key leaves the Pi. Keep Pi address stable and outside conflicting DHCP allocations; do not enable a second DHCP server. Selecting a component shows only its incoming/outgoing arrows, including owned children.
